purpose: Example brief for a SaaS product showcase: one page, no sign-ups, no database, no owner area. It shows the shape and the defaults only. Every idea-specific value belongs to a made-up product and must be replaced by what the person says in the interview.

site.name: Tallyfold
site.one_liner: Expense reports that fill themselves in for small finance teams.

core_idea.product: Matches every card charge to a receipt and a category.
core_idea.pain: Finance leads chase receipts every month-end and the close takes days.
core_idea.solution: Charges and receipts are matched automatically, so the close takes hours.

audience.icp: Finance leads at companies of 20 to 200 people who chase receipts every month-end.
audience.alternatives: Spreadsheets, shared inboxes, and expense tools that need every receipt keyed in.
frustrations: Close takes days instead of hours

main_button.label: Get started
main_button.note: A link the owner sets later: a sign-up page, a booking page or a mailto. With no link the button scrolls to the pricing section (the closing section when pricing is off) and is flagged 'Set your link'.

blocks.headline: Month-end, without the chase.
blocks.subheadline: Tallyfold matches every card charge to a receipt and a category, so your team stops hunting for paperwork.

items.title: Receipts matched automatically
items.text: Each charge finds its receipt without anyone keying it in.

items.title: Categories learned from your books
items.text: Suggestions improve as you approve them.

items.title: Month-end close in hours
items.text: Unmatched items are listed, so nothing hides.

items.title: Connect your cards

items.title: Forward receipts

items.title: Review and export
items.text: Approve the matches and send the file to your accountant.

blocks.heading: Simple plans
rules: Prices the owner typed stay exactly as typed.
Calculated amounts are whole dollars, rounded down: yearly = floor(monthly x 12 x (1 - discount)); per-month equivalent = floor(yearly / 12).
Each price is defined once in the plan data and derived everywhere else (cards, FAQ, comparison table).

stack: See the Builder's knowledge/stack.json. Those decisions are fixed. This pack deploys as a static-style site: no database, no sign-ups, no owner area.
not_in_this_version: Customer logos or user counts unless the owner supplies them
assumptions: Everything about Tallyfold is made up for this example.
Yearly billing at 20% off is an example the owner would confirm.
Testimonials and pricing are placeholders; the owner reviews and fixes them.
owner_vision: A finance lead should feel calm and in control. The page should never feel like a bank or promise anything about moving money.
